function generateItemName(e) {
	if (!e.isOfType(`armor`, `shield`, `weapon`)) return e.name;
	let [t, n, r] = e.isOfType(`armor`) ? [
		CONFIG.PF2E.baseArmorTypes,
		Jn.armor.property,
		Jn.armor.resilient
	] : e.isOfType(`shield`) ? [
		CONFIG.PF2E.baseShieldTypes,
		null,
		null
	] : [
		{
			...CONFIG.PF2E.baseWeaponTypes,
			...CONFIG.PF2E.baseShieldTypes
		},
		Jn.weapon.property,
		Jn.weapon.striking
	], i = e._source.name, a = e.baseType ?? ``;
	if (!a || !(a in t) || e.isSpecific || i !== _loc(t[a] ?? ``)) return e.name;
	let { runes: s, material: c, grade: l } = e.system, u = a ? c.type && [
		`hide-armor`,
		`steel-shield`,
		`wooden-shield`
	].includes(a) ? _loc(`TYPES.Item.${e.type}`) : _loc(t[a] ?? ``) : e.name, d = c.type && _loc(CONFIG.PF2E.preciousMaterials[c.type]);
	if (l && !AutomaticBonusProgression.isEnabled(e.actor)) {
		let e = {
			base: u,
			material: d,
			grade: _loc(CONFIG.PF2E.grades[l])
		}, t = [`Grade`, e.material && `Material`].filter(o).join(``);
		return _loc(`PF2E.Item.Physical.GeneratedName.${t}`, e);
	} else {
		let t = `potency` in s ? s.potency : null, i = `resilient` in s ? s.resilient : `striking` in s ? s.striking : null, a = {
			base: u,
			material: d,
			potency: t,
			reinforcing: `reinforcing` in s && _loc(Es[Number(s.reinforcing)] ?? ``) || null,
			fundamental2: i && r && _loc(r[i]?.name ?? ``) || null
		};
		if (`property` in s && n) for (let e of [
			0,
			1,
			2,
			3
		]) a[`property${e + 1}`] = _loc(n[s.property[e]]?.name ?? ``) || null;
		let c = (() => {
			let e = [
				a.potency ? `Potency` : null,
				a.reinforcing ? `Reinforcing` : null,
				a.fundamental2 && `Fundamental2`,
				a.property4 ? `FourProperties` : a.property3 ? `ThreeProperties` : a.property2 ? `TwoProperties` : a.property1 ? `OneProperty` : null,
				a.material && `Material`
			].filter(o).join(``) || null;
			return e && _loc(e);
		})();
		return c ? _loc(`PF2E.Item.Physical.GeneratedName.${c}`, a) : e.name;
	}
}
